A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ServImage study. Scientific sections, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–I can be matched completely; v2's extra page results from bibliography reflow.

before.justification: V1 reports original evaluations of 16 image models, human acceptance annotations, payment-prediction experiments, ablations and judge-validation results.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results, including the revenue comparisons, payment-prediction accuracy and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The BRF/VEQ/CNS scoring procedure, two-stage concept and payment predictor, losses and LoRA components are unchanged in Sections 3–4 and Appendix G.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 1,070 commercial tasks spanning Portrait, Product and Digital, with unchanged generation/editing coverage, candidate images and settlement scenarios.

E2.justification: The same 16 image systems, seven metric comparators in Figure 5 and general-purpose VLM baselines in Figure 4(b) participate. Citation-format changes do not alter comparator membership.

E3.justification: Task-level splitting, annotation procedures, settlement rules, evaluation metrics and training settings remain unchanged. Appendix G retains the same five-epoch and two-epoch training stages.

E4.justification: Both retain the Table 4 component ablations, Appendix C cases, Appendix H human and multi-judge checks, and Appendix I analysis of 21,557 rejected samples.

E5.justification: Figure 3 retains the same confidence-interval reporting, and annotation agreement, judge correlations and Table 12 Cohen's d reporting are unchanged. No run-count or seed information is added.

E6.justification: Matched main-text and appendix results are unchanged. Examples include Gemini-Banana-Pro's $243.98k revenue and 82.7% share in Table 2, 82.00% prediction accuracy in Table 4, and the failure statistics in Table 12.

T1.justification: The task formulation, concept and payment losses, and economic definitions in Equations 1–8 are retained without mathematical revisions or added proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same benchmark, scoring and payment-model contributions, economic-evaluation positioning and performance claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of commercial acceptance and failure causes remain unchanged, as do limitations concerning Chinese-platform coverage, binary payment labels and iterative workflows. Appendix G retains its qualification of automatic settlement as a proxy.

D1.justification: V2 adds previously absent documentation URLs for evaluated systems, including Imagen 4 and GPT-image-1/mini, modestly improving resource traceability. Implementation details and the benchmark repository destination remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. LMM4LMM receives year and conference metadata; other changes concern reference formatting and source URLs rather than additional related work.

P1.justification: V2 changes one affiliation from the Institute of Botany to the Institute of Automation, repairs email separators, displays the repository URL explicitly and revises bibliography formatting. The scientific narrative and section order remain stable.

P2.justification: The expanded bibliography changes page layout, and figure rendering differs slightly. Some Figure 3–4 labels clip in one local renderer but display intact in another. Scientific displays, captions and appendix examples retain their content.

improvement.justification: Direct model-documentation links, the completed LMM4LMM reference and corrected contact formatting modestly improve traceability and usability. Scientific evidence remains unchanged, while small reader-dependent figure-rendering issues temper the editorial benefit.
